task.title: Восстановиться после ошибок интеграции и записать audit evidence
task.shortdesc: Обрабатывайте validation, import/export, readiness и revision failures без unsafe retries и скрытых transaction assumptions.

prereq.p: Используйте процедуру, когда внешний продукт получил failed BPM API response, timeout, unexpected response body, устаревший expected_revision или mismatch export evidence.

context.p: Процедура связывает API-HEALTH-001, API-HEALTH-002, API-PROFILE-003, API-PROFILE-005, API-FF-001, API-FF-002 и API-VAL-001. Она определяет operator evidence; BPM не предоставляет distributed tracing, automatic rollback, bulk transaction recovery или webhook notifications.

info.p: Record whether the failure is health/readiness, validation, import, export, read, patch, conflict, timeout, or transport. Preserve HTTP status such as 400, 404, 409, 415, 422, or 503.

step.cmd: Зафиксируйте external desired state и BPM observation.

info.p: Сохраните request method, path, sanitized payload hash, profile ID, observed revision, schema channel, response body, response time, and control-product run ID. Never include secrets or private host names in shared evidence.

step.cmd: Повторно проверьте health и перечитайте profile при recoverable failure.

info.p: Request examples: GET $BPM_BASE_URL/health, GET $BPM_BASE_URL/health/ready, and GET $BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles/42. If the profile revision changed, return to comparison and approval.

step.cmd: Повторяйте validate или export только после operator-approved decision.

info.p: For validation, repeat POST $BPM_BASE_URL/api/validate/release-152 with the same candidate document. For export, repeat GET $BPM_BASE_URL/api/export/profiles/42/firefox/policies.json?pretty=1 and compare the exported document hash.

step.cmd: Остановите mutation retries при stale revision или ambiguous evidence.

info.p: If expected_revision returns 409, if export hash differs, or if validation errors changed, do not continue the old run. Open a new external run with fresh read, comparison, and reviewer approval.

step.cmd: Опубликуйте audit record во внешнюю system of record.

info.note: BPM stores profile state but does not store a complete integration audit trail. The external product must record owner, decision, ticket, retry count, stop reason, old and new revisions, hashes, and operator notes.

result.p: Failures are recoverable only through explicit evidence, fresh reads, and operator-approved retry decisions, not through blind replay. Результат фиксируется с теми же API identifiers и evidence boundaries.

postreq.p: After recovery, link the audit record to the successful profile revision or mark the integration run as stopped. Следующий шаг выполняется только после сохранения audit evidence.
